answer: A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The comet multiplier is published, charged in sable, and garden lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 10 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 3855 identities would post 4753 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
